_purpose: Records the engine-side classification ladder these vendored copies were last reconciled against. Read by group-em-enter.py's --local path so drift is a visible fact rather than a difference in the answer.
_why_content_hashes_not_a_commit_sha: The published mirror can carry current file contents ahead of its own HEAD (a percolate writes, the commit lands separately). A sha would then name a vintage older than what is actually on disk. Hashing the files answers the question the operator has -- is the ladder I am about to run the same one the engine runs -- without depending on anyone's commit timing.
